scope: 24 original complete-site templates (separate from 157 showroom components)
rightsPolicy: Every remote asset remains unapproved pending verified source/creator/license/depictee-property rights and validated local derivatives. Matching component stock references does NOT confer approval.

pilotVisualReview.notes: Poster depicts a person in flowing green studio fashion clothing with a green backdrop, visible white tracking crosses, and white geometric platforms. The 3:5 portrait crop keeps the subject and platforms while trimming outer set pieces. Need actual OFFCUT title contrast/crop acceptance on phone; source photographer, depicted-person release and commercial redistribution remain unverified.
Retail interior shows visible U.S. Navy branding; person/property/brand use context remains unverified. Phone crops retain displays, but not approved.
Banana still-life is truncated by phone center and attention cover crops; full-frame contain with matching background is a safer preliminary candidate.
Photo shows person with sunglasses/shopping bags. Attention phone crop nearly excludes the person; center composition retains their upper body. Model/brand rights unverified.
Branded outdoor gear flat lay on wooden boards over a map. Narrow cover crop cuts peripheral boots and pack; not a photographed Route Kit. Replace with brand-neutral relevant navigation kit.

White performance coupe parked in a dim multi-car indoor storage area, not a silver sports car. Centered 3:5 phone cover clips much of the foreground vehicle; attention crop retains its front but loses setting.
Lamp against green wall; original alt claiming desk objects was inaccurate and corrected. Attention phone crop better retains lamp; rights still unverified.
Orange-lit conical tent in dark woods. Center phone crop keeps tent; source does not demonstrate fictional two-person storm shelter, pitching claims or ownership.
Person in floral summer dress near coast; phone cover crops lose much of wider composition. A replacement may be preferable if face-forward portrait required; model rights unverified.

Beachfront homes on supports above a sandy coastal shore with visible surf, not a verified Georgian Bay waterfront residence and not the photo used for the 'Drift House' hero. Narrow phone crops focus on the elevated decks; 16:9 stress crop loses much of the upper architecture.
Man in dark sweater against black; 16:9 desktop crop cuts his face. Vertical phone framing preserves portrait better.
Person in yellow outfit on basketball court; 16:9 wide crop removes head and legs. Phone vertical preserves scene.
Woman in dark clothing against charcoal studio backdrop; old natural-light alt inaccurate. Wide crop cuts face; opening-left 3:4 desktop and 3:5 phone need CSS review.
Person in sunglasses, red lettered shirt and jacket under blue sky; 16:9 wide crop cuts eyewear/face. Opening-right 5:4 desktop and 3:4 phone need review; garment logo/lettering rights unresolved.
Woman in patterned jacket and white collar against rust red wall; phone attention crop shifts face toward edge; centered crop initially preferable. Old generic alt clarified.
Blue-lit portrait against lilac background, not dark blurred as previously described. Both image alts corrected. Feature and gallery placements need separate fit review.
Bright blue performance coupe parked outdoors on desert ground at sunset, not a red vehicle or post-detailing job. Narrow centered 3:5 crops cut away much of the vehicle.

Silver-gray BMW performance sedan parked on a road at dusk with hills behind, not a close-up of freshly detailed bodywork. Portrait crops keep the car; trade dress and client context remain unverified.

Small white hut on a snow-covered frozen lake in bright low winter light; not a photograph of the advertised Lake Suite or verifiably a Muskoka rental. Wide crop retains hut; narrow 3:4 crops cut some shoreline but remain readable. Replace suite image before publication.
Metal kettle on a compact stove with a mug in front of turquoise tent. Portrait crop retains camping scene, but does not depict a confirmed RANGE/FOUND enamel cup.
Green hiking pack on rocky ground beside flowing water. Portrait crops preserve pack; image cannot substantiate invented waxed ripstop or aluminium frame claims.
Hiker with large pack in evergreen forest, not a visible glacier or mountain landscape. Corrected unsupported hero location caption. Review focal point behind mobile headline.

Small cabin on vivid turquoise lake with steep pine-covered mountains behind; an alpine scene that does not credibly depict the claimed Lake Rosseau/Muskoka house. Wide crop loses mountain context, portrait retains it. Replace as featured property photograph.
Hiker wearing orange padded jacket touching a summit marker; 4:5 phone view preserves figure. Cannot establish the fictional product specifications; model and brand concerns open.

Person wearing a cap and gloves machine-polishing a black vehicle panel near the side mirror. A 16:9 stress crop excludes the worker's face; tall portrait shows person and panel. Model and workplace rights remain unverified.

Interior bedroom with exposed timber beams and stone fireplace; broad visual description matches. 3:4 portrait cover trims the bed and fireplace edge; need real CSS room-card crop check. No evidence the depicted room exists at a fictional retreat.
Dark cooking pot on a small gas canister by a stone wall. Wide 16:9 stress crop truncates fuel canister; portrait view is closer to intended 4:5 product card.

Modern waterfront house with orange roof/trim accents, timber/stone cladding, landscaping and a small dock visible. The photo is not known to show the fictional Drift House or Thornbury. The landscape original is reasonably framed in 16:9; narrow phone crops remove some shore and building facade.

The North Face-marked stuff sack and Hydro Flask-marked bottle beside orange fabric. Does not depict a repair roll; replace rather than imply the pictured branded products are fictional RANGE/FOUND goods.

Dark living area silhouettes furniture in front of large windows overlooking water and vivid sunset clouds. This supports a lake-view interior photo description, but not the fictional Tiny Township listing, bed count or shoreline footage. Portrait crop keeps the central water view and loses side furnishings.

Wood-paneled room with bed and orange freestanding wood stove, not a masonry fireplace; corrected inaccurate alt text. Portrait crop keeps stove and partial bed. Forest-view and property identity remain unverified.

Unfurnished concrete room with full-height glazing overlooking a valley, broad water and prominent mountain peaks. Mountain scenery contradicts the implied Georgian Bay setting; should be replaced with appropriate setting before commercial use. Centered 3:5 phone crop preserves most glazing but loses outer edges and adjacent context.
Blue-grey HOKA-branded high-top trail footwear with Vibram marking on bare ground under open sky. Not leather rebuildable Ridge Boot; replace before commercial presentation.

Warm sunset over a calm lake, low dock extending from one shore, foreground leaves at left. Crop options retain sunset and dock with different foreground balance; real text-over-image contrast and exact phone hero focal point require browser QA. Lake/location not verified as Rosseau.

pilotVideoReview.notes: HEAD succeeded but did not return Content-Length. Playback frames, duration, codec, exact file size, creator and depicted-person releases were not inspected. The optional remote video is now opt-in, preload none and has no source URL assigned until click. A 1080p-or-smaller rights-cleared rendition is still required before production.
